reason: Automates restarting the DSH web process after plugin installation or updates by locating and terminating the port-3080 DSH process, then launching it again in the background.

summaries.zh: 在插件安装或更新后，通过定位并重启 DSH Web 进程来自动使插件生效。
summaries.en: Automatically restarts the DSH web process after plugin installation or updates so changes take effect.

capabilities: Uses shell execution to perform a delayed background restart
Locates the process listening on TCP port 3080 and verifies its command line
Terminates the matching DSH web process
Starts a detached dsh web process with nohup
